game.core.campaign.root.title: The Waystone at Brackenford
game.core.campaign.root.premise: In a warm frontier village beside a smaller, ancient forest, a lull in goblin attacks and a forgotten waystone cellar hint that something old is waking beneath the trees.
partyGoals: Build trust with the people of Brackenford and learn what has changed along the old patrol road.
Follow the clues toward the waystone cellar without losing sight of the village's safety.
toneAndBoundaries: Cozy high fantasy with poetic scenery, kind communities, and space for quiet relationships.
Mysteries, riddles, hidden quests, and occasional frightening danger are welcome; player choices matter and companions are not disposable.
